description:
What's the most this buyer can afford? The reverse of `affordability` — 'what price
    can I afford?' instead of 'can I afford this specific home?'. Solves for the maximum
    home price under standard lender limits: a front-end DTI cap (default 28% = housing /
    gross income) and a back-end cap (default 36% = housing + other debts / gross income).
    If `liquid_savings` is given, also caps by the cash available for down payment + closing
    and reports which limit binds. Returns the affordable price, the PITI and DTIs at that
    price, and the cash to close. Pass `address` to ground property tax + insurance in the
    ZIP's real rates.

    This is a lender-limit ceiling, not a comfort recommendation — feed the result into
    `affordability` (or buy_vs_rent) to check monthly slack and whether buying pencils.

address.description: Full US street address, or a bare 5-digit ZIP. Pass it whenever it is known: it grounds property tax, insurance and the appreciation forecast in that ZIP's real figures instead of national defaults.
address.title: Address

annual_income.description: Gross household income before tax, in whole US dollars per year, e.g. 140000.
annual_income.title: Annual Income

back_end_dti_pct.description: Back-end DTI cap as a PERCENT: housing plus other debts, divided by gross income. The lender standard is 36. Only change it if the user names a different limit.
back_end_dti_pct.title: Back End Dti Pct

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as a PERCENT of price: 20 means 20%. Not a fraction (not 0.20).
down_payment_pct.title: Down Payment Pct

fixed_rate.description: Mortgage interest rate as an annual PERCENT: 6.75 means 6.75%. Not a decimal (not 0.0675).
fixed_rate.title: Fixed Rate

front_end_dti_pct.description: Front-end DTI cap as a PERCENT: housing cost divided by gross income. The lender standard is 28. Only change it if the user names a different limit.
front_end_dti_pct.title: Front End Dti Pct

hoa_monthly.description: HOA or condo fee in US dollars per month. 0 for most single-family homes.
hoa_monthly.title: Hoa Monthly

insurance_rate.description: Annual homeowners insurance as a PERCENT of home value: 0.45 means 0.45%/yr. Leave unset to use the regional default.
insurance_rate.title: Insurance Rate

liquid_savings.description: Cash available for down payment and closing costs, in US dollars. Supplying it adds the post-closing cash cushion and the cash-limited price check.
liquid_savings.title: Liquid Savings

monthly_debts.description: Recurring DEBT obligations a lender counts, in dollars per month: car payment, student loan, minimum credit-card payment. This feeds DTI. Do NOT put groceries, utilities or childcare here.
monthly_debts.title: Monthly Debts

property_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as a PERCENT of home value: 0.55 means 0.55%/yr. Leave unset to use the ZIP's real rate when `address` is given.
property_tax_rate.title: Property Tax Rate

name: affordable_price
